purpose: Determine whether the discovered Gaussian-noise failure is specific to CIFAKE-CIFAR10 authentic rows or generalizes to a new class-balanced 32x32 authentic source.

authentic_gate.source: CIFAR-100 official test split through the pinned uoft-cs/cifar100 mirror
authentic_gate.selection: 10 lowest image SHA-256 values within each of 100 fine classes

models.blend: 0.75 * v6 probability + 0.25 * v9 probability in CUDA FP16 before FP32 conversion

conditions.name: clean
conditions.definition: Resize shorter side to 336, center crop 336x336, scale to [0,1], normalize with checkpoint mean/std

conditions.name: noise_sigma_0.10
conditions.definition: The same clean path plus independent Gaussian tensor noise sigma 0.10, clipped to [0,1], before normalization

fake_reference.source: The 288 fake rows from the already-frozen first Qwen prompt-holdout prediction files
fake_reference.warning: Only the authentic side is new. The comparison does not add a new generator family or independent fake acquisition pipeline.

primary_diagnostic: ROC AUC after combining the new 1000 authentic scores with the unchanged 288 frozen Qwen fake scores for the same condition

predeclared_interpretation_for_blend_noi.below_0.50: general low-resolution authentic ranking inversion confirmed on the new source
predeclared_interpretation_for_blend_noi.0.70_to_below_0.80: material risk; result is inconclusive between a general failure and strong source dependence
predeclared_interpretation_for_blend_noi.0.80_or_above: CIFAKE-specific or source-interaction explanation becomes more likely, but low-resolution robustness is not proved

additional_flags.clean_auc_below_0.80: clean low-resolution transfer is itself weak
additional_flags.noise_authentic_mean_above_fake_mean: mean-score inversion regardless of the aggregate AUC band
additional_flags.blend_noise_auc_more_than_0.01_below_v6: the ensemble introduces an additional low-resolution/noise risk

decision_boundary: Diagnosis only. Never train, tune, calibrate, choose a threshold or choose a blend weight using these revealed rows. Any repair requires lawful disjoint training data and a separately frozen evaluation gate.
forbidden_resources: The organizer demo-only 4,998 COCO plus 8,843 DALL-E Advanced resources are absent and remain prohibited for training, tuning, selection and calibration.
